metric_definition: Equal complete reserved-group mean MAE in physical units; RMSE square root is taken within group, before averaging groups.
independent_unit: whole control setting across turbines and downstream sections

input_units.St: actuation Strouhal number, 0 labels greedy baseline
input_units.background_u: m/s; independent no-turbine uu at matched grid; linear x interpolation only at 4D

scope_limit: Only four controls and one wind-tunnel system; three development controls and one reserved. Spatial errors describe field interpolation/transfer, not independent grid replicates.
calibration_note: Independent no-turbine grids; x4D interpolates empty2D/5D, WT2 local+5D matches empty7D/9D. All new baselines have identical calibration.
timing_contract: Fixed independent no-turbine background measurement and geometry/settings; no wake response input.
exposure_notice: ALL original confirmation exposed; no fresh confirmation; diagnostics opened only after candidate/stopping freeze; all future evaluations are retrospective

uncertainty.reason: Shared source system/people/materials, temporal dependence or small reserved-group counts do not justify precise population-level confidence. Group effects are descriptive; no row bootstrap.

review_criteria.name: Prediction-time information
review_criteria.requirement: Verify native anchors and permitted information: Geometry and actuation settings only; no reserved velocity or rotor-equivalent speed is a predictor.

review_criteria.name: Validation and leakage
review_criteria.requirement: Inspect complete training/tuning groups and processing fits. Keep linked units together. Distinguish original held-out evidence from the currently exposed cohort.

review_criteria.name: Executable equations and parameters
review_criteria.requirement: Reproduce submitted predictions; inspect correspondence between written equations and code, all coefficients, learned transformations, hidden calibration and model complexity.

review_criteria.name: Units and scientific interpretation
review_criteria.requirement: Check units, physical signs/limits, measurement preprocessing, identifiability and source-specific confounding. Source-native lidar-derived uu grids; grid cells are correlated interpolated products. Raw vlos retained upstream. Rotor-equivalent wind and virtual turbine power are excluded as targets and predictors. No cubic-power identity is counted as a rule. ABL Type II only.

review_criteria.name: Controls, uncertainty and failures
review_criteria.requirement: Require falsifying tests, residual checks, sensitivity/ablation evidence and preserved negative results. Use independent groups rather than row-level pseudo-replication.

review_criteria.name: Comparators and practical value
review_criteria.requirement: Compare every frozen baseline under equal information/coverage; justify improvements in physical units and simplicity, not just best-case rows or extra fitted constants.

review_criteria.name: Prior work and novelty
review_criteria.requirement: Disclose source analyses and literature-search records. Separate reproduction from extension; a novelty claim requires independent literature and scientific adjudication.

review_criteria.name: Scope and reproducibility
review_criteria.requirement: State validated systems/conditions, failure modes and out-of-domain limits. Fresh scientific confirmation requires new, unexposed groups with a preregistered protocol.
